_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a sportsperson. 1. The Athletes must represent Jharkhand in competitions recognized by national/international Olympic committees. 1. The Athletes must have secured a medal or participated in such competitions. 1. The record-setting athletes are eligible for additional cash incentives. 1. Awards for one competition are based on the highest achievement if multiple medals are won.
